Circular saws (single- or multi-blade) - sawing machinery with fixed blade(s) during cutting, having a fixed bed or support with manual feed of the workpiece or with a demountable power feed - for working with wood and material with similar physical characteristics or for working with meat and material with similar physical characteristics 1.2. Portable chainsaws for woodworking 9.
